payload.recallText: We grew up around the Kennedy's and were Irish Catholic. We lived within 20 miles of them. One day when out driving Micayla started crying because the news about JFK's death anniversary was on the radio. My dad pulled over on I-95 and turned around to look at Micayla and told her never apologize for crying about that man. My 3 aunts took us to Hyannis and the beach to swim., They were putting sunscreen on their feet, their hands and their shoulders, turned their chairs towards the Kennedy compound and started snooping with their biconoculars watching the Kennedy compound. One said Rose is out for a walk and Ethel look drawn and tired. One Aunt wanted to know how old Ethel was so they figured it out by basing it on how old Ethel was when JFK died, and then on Rose's birthday and one other factor, so they decided she was 81. This is how they entertained themselves. Once they didn't know people were there so they drew out the Kennedy family tree to figure out which side of the family they were on. They mentioned that Jackie didn't come around much anymore and then just gave each other knowing looks. They said hope no one tells Ethel about Robert as she will never get over it. Now the aunts weren't paying attention to the kids in the water to notice that they pulled themselves up onto a boat float and got pulled out by the Rip Tide into the Atlantic. The swells blew water into their faces and by the time they wiped it out they were out past where the ferry boat drives. By this time their Aunts were mere dots hopping up and down on the beach when they had noticed them missing. Michael and ? motored out to them and picked them up off the float. They were saved and rescued by the motorboat! They got within range of their aunts seeing them more clearly than just dots hopping up and down on the beach and knew that they were in trouble. One aunt when anxious calls out names and addresses. So it was wierd to hear Rose on Asylum street, which is where we grew up. Another aunt had vague threatening sentences like, I'll protect you from the water now just lay down on that beach towel for now. The third aunt said I know what to do and gave them something to eat?
